what: What the design site's Vehicles review page shows for this car (R126). tools/vehicles/review/build.mjs turns this, vehicle.json, the bake and assets/profiles/<id>.json into art/ui/poc/vehicles/<id>/; tools/vehicles/review/check.mjs fails if any Vehicles-contract item is missing. Paths are repo-relative.
name: Cruz Missile
summary: Reworked the actual body after owner feedback: longer overhangs with frozen wheel hubs, a broad curved nose with swept-back corners, upright facet-projected lamps, rolled upper flanks and crowned bonnet sections. Side glazing follows the actual greenhouse triangles, hidden damage bays sit inside the sloped doors, rear graphics follow the sculpted boot/bumper, and cheap repeated wheel detail funds the body. Intact exported triangles: 2052 / 891 / 576 against unchanged 2800 / 900 / 600. Front lamp envelope IoU improves from about 0.53 to 0.72; front silhouette improves while side/rear and coarse whole-view scores regress slightly. These measured local gains and inspected shaded comparisons are a review candidate, not an owner likeness acceptance.
feedback: Comment on this page (what to change, which view or state); the session turns each comment into a bug bead that cites this page and the car's id.

reference.note: Unchanged references, horizontal 50 m end diagnostics and 10 m side/top. Hero azimuth corrected from 52 to 34 degrees to match the reference front/side balance; low 2 degree pitch. Both candidates were recaptured. Generated views remain uncalibrated. New independent body/axle, nose-section, lamp-plane and flank tests reject the real previous source at every tier.
